records.label: THESIS / 001
records.title: An identity is not its container.
records.summary: A working premise: continuity should not be defined by a machine, model provider, or network address. The distinction shapes every decision that follows.

records.label: RESEARCH / LOCAL PROOF
records.title: The root stays put.
records.summary: An earlier two-machine experiment verified a public identity without moving the root private key. This is a local verification result, not a claim of external ownership.

records.label: RESEARCH / PROTOTYPE
records.title: Receipts are not location.
records.summary: A signed result receipt can bind work to a pinned key and request. It does not, by itself, prove which machine performed the work. Remote-host trust remains a separate problem.
